description: This file defines the CellReferenceHelper class which provides utility methods for handling cell references within a spreadsheet, such as updating cell references, checking if a cell is within a delete range, and managing absolute/relative references. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: CellReferenceHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing and updating cell references within a spreadsheet, considering absolute and relative references, and handling ranges for deletion and updates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a reference cell address, number of columns, and number of rows for reference updates.

methods.name: beforeCellAddress
methods.description: Returns the reference cell address used as a baseline for updates.

methods.name: refreshRequired
methods.description: Determines if the current reference parameters differ from given parameters, indicating an update is needed.

methods.name: updateCellReference
methods.description: Updates a cell reference based on the reference helper's configuration, optionally considering absolute references.

methods.name: cellAddressInDeleteRange
methods.description: Checks if a given cell address falls within the range of cells that are set for deletion based on the reference helper's parameters.

methods.name: updateColumnReference
methods.description: Calculates a new column reference string based on a new column index and the current offset.

methods.name: updateRowReference
methods.description: Calculates a new row reference string based on a new row index and the current offset.
